cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Close It Properly
cards.instruction: Keep them present until both of you complete the ritual that formally ends this role, meeting, or relationship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you leave tonight's book club, we close the discussion together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I said goodnight. My taxi's coming.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll say 'chapter closed'; you answer 'until next time.' Then we can leave.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's here. I'll say my bit from the car.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll come to your window. Give me ten seconds for 'chapter closed' and your reply.

reason: Preserve the strong ritual and taxi compromise but trim the duplicate final time-limit explanation; A adjusts location without surrendering B required response.
